title: My invoices
heading: Request an invoice and track its progress
subtitle: Choose a saved invoice profile and paid bills, then enter the amount requested from each bill. The back office confirms the invoice type and reviews the request.
noticeTitle: The back office confirms the invoice type
noticeDescription: You do not choose an invoice type. A submitted request first enters review and immediately reserves the invoiceable amount from each selected bill.

profile.empty: No active invoice profile is available. Add or reactivate one under Invoice profiles first.

invoice.empty: No paid bill currently has an invoiceable balance.
invoice.differentCurrency: One request can combine bills in one currency only
invoice.selectionLimit: One request can include up to 20 bills
invoice.amountRequired: Enter an amount for this bill
invoice.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero with valid decimal places
invoice.amountTooLarge: The amount cannot exceed this bill's invoiceable balance

submitHint: After submission, this profile snapshot and bill allocation are frozen. Later profile edits do not change this request.

messages.created: Invoice request submitted for back-office review.
messages.reused: The earlier successful submission of this same request was recovered.
messages.createFailed: Submission failed. Check the amounts, refresh, and try again.

history.title: Request history
history.description: Only your requests and customer-visible processing reasons appear here.

reason.buyer_or_tax_information_incorrect: The invoice profile or tax information needs correction
reason.amount_or_billing_invoice_adjustment_req: The requested amount or selected bills need adjustment
reason.duplicate_request: This request duplicates an existing request
reason.business_not_invoiceable: This business cannot currently be invoiced
reason.order_or_refund_changed: The order or refund situation changed
reason.other: The request could not continue. Contact the merchant for details

loadFailed: Invoiceable information is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
